prompt: What does vmnic0 identify in ESXi?
options: An adapter interface that ESXi can use as a physical-network uplink
The host management IP interface itself
A virtual disk inside a guest
A DNS suffix for a virtual switch
en: vmnic names identify ESXi network adapters, distinct from VMkernel vmk interfaces.
ru: vmnic ESXi network adapter ka naam hai; VMkernel vmk interface se alag hai.

prompt: What is the purpose of assigning a vmnic as a standard-switch uplink?
options: Provide a path from the local virtual switch toward an external network
Assign every guest a static IP
Create reverse DNS records automatically
Mount a storage datastore automatically
en: An uplink provides a network path; addressing and storage configuration remain separate.
ru: Uplink network path deta hai; addressing aur storage configuration alag rehti hain.

prompt: How does a guest vNIC differ from an ESXi vmnic?
options: The guest vNIC attaches a VM; the vmnic can uplink the ESXi switch
Both are always the same named interface
The guest vNIC always owns the host management address
The vmnic is a DNS zone file
en: Guest interfaces and host uplink adapters occupy different layers of the topology.
ru: Guest interfaces aur host uplink adapters topology ki alag layers par hain.

prompt: Where is an ESXi host’s management IP normally assigned?
options: A VMkernel adapter such as vmk0
Directly to the standard-switch uplink vmnic
To the switch label alone
To each guest’s virtual disk
en: The vmnic carries frames while the VMkernel interface provides the host IP endpoint.
ru: vmnic frames carry karta hai; VMkernel interface host IP endpoint deta hai.

prompt: Can one vmnic simultaneously belong to two different standard switches?
options: No; standard-switch membership must be reassigned
Yes; every adapter belongs to all switches by default
Only if both switches use the same label
Only if the adapter reports 10 Gbit/s
en: The existing assignment must be handled before moving the adapter.
ru: Adapter move karne se pehle existing assignment handle hoti hai.

prompt: What does link status Up establish by itself?
options: The adapter reports a connected link
All remote application ports are reachable
All VLANs and routes are correct
An end-to-end performance benchmark passed
en: Link status is one layer of evidence, not a complete connectivity test.
ru: Link status aik layer ki evidence hai, complete connectivity test nahin.

prompt: What does 10000 Full mean in a reported link field?
options: Reported 10000 Mbit/s, full duplex
Guaranteed 10000 Mbit/s Internet download speed
Guaranteed double speed with any second adapter
A verified recovery time of 10000 milliseconds
en: The field describes link characteristics, not measured application throughput.
ru: Field link characteristics batata hai, measured application throughput nahin.

prompt: What does an unclaimed adapter mean in the captured switch-assignment context?
options: It is not assigned to a virtual switch at that checkpoint
It has no possible MAC address
It must be physically broken
It automatically has an IP of 0.0.0.0
en: Assignment state differs from link health and IP configuration.
ru: Assignment state link health aur IP configuration se alag hai.

prompt: In nested ESXi, what can the displayed physical adapter actually be?
options: Virtual NIC hardware presented by VMware Workstation
Only a dedicated physical desktop PCI card
The Windows client resolver cache
A VMkernel TCP/IP stack
en: Nested ESXi sees the outer hypervisor’s presented NIC hardware.
ru: Nested ESXi outer hypervisor ka presented NIC hardware dekhta hai.

prompt: What does the Observed IP Ranges column represent?
options: Information inferred from observed network traffic
The configured static IP assigned directly to each vmnic
The complete host routing table
Proof that every address in the range is free
en: Observed ranges are not a replacement for VMkernel IP settings or actual reachability tests.
ru: Observed ranges VMkernel IP settings ya actual reachability tests ka badal nahin.

prompt: vmnic1 appears as (New) under Active before saving the dialog. What is established?
options: A pending configuration choice, not a confirmed saved assignment
The final configuration has already been applied
A live failover test has completed
The host now has a new management IP
en: Pending UI changes must be saved and verified before they are called applied.
ru: Pending UI changes ko applied kehne se pehle save aur verify karna chahiye.

prompt: A saved topology shows vmnic0 and vmnic1 on vSwitch0. Which conclusion is supported?
options: Both are assigned at that captured checkpoint
A single transfer now has guaranteed 20 Gbit/s
A controlled failure test has passed
The links use independent physical routers
en: Membership is visible, but throughput and physical independence need their own evidence.
ru: Membership nazar aati hai; throughput aur physical independence ki evidence alag chahiye.

prompt: An administrator removes vmnic1 from vSwitch0. Is this automatically a real link-failure test?
options: No; administrative removal and controlled link-failure recovery are different
Yes; any configuration change proves failover
Yes; the removed adapter is now a standby link
Only if vmnic1 had a reverse DNS record
en: A failover test monitors traffic while configured alternate paths handle a link fault.
ru: Failover test mein configured alternate paths ke saath link fault par traffic monitor hoti hai.

prompt: The original storage setup moved vmnic1 to vSwitch1. Why was freeing its old assignment relevant?
options: It could not remain a member of both standard switches simultaneously
Its IP address had to match the datastore name
The DNS zone required two adapters with identical names
A virtual switch can never use a connected adapter
en: The adapter had to be available for the new switch assignment.
ru: Nayi switch assignment ke liye adapter available hona chahiye tha.

prompt: A later inventory shows different uplink assignments from the earlier screenshots. What should documentation do?
options: Record both chronological checkpoints and verify live state before new changes
Treat the oldest image as permanently current
Assume every intervening operation was captured
Delete the later evidence without inspection
en: Historical configuration changes should not be collapsed into one contradictory final inventory.
ru: Historical changes ko aik contradictory final inventory mein mix nahin karna chahiye.

prompt: How should vmnic4 be matched to an outer Workstation adapter before a link test?
options: Compare actual MAC addresses and inspect the outer network mapping
Assume Network Adapter 5 must always be vmnic4
Choose whichever adapter appears first alphabetically
Use the guest’s DNS suffix as the hardware mapping
en: MAC-based mapping avoids relying on adapter-order assumptions.
ru: MAC mapping adapter order ke assumptions se bachati hai.

prompt: Two nested uplinks use the same desktop physical NIC and Windows host. What remains shared?
options: The physical NIC and host can fail and affect both paths
Nothing; two virtual NICs guarantee independent hardware
Only the DNS alias spelling
Only the guest’s wallpaper
en: Virtual path duplication does not eliminate shared physical dependencies.
ru: Virtual paths do honay se shared physical dependencies khatam nahin hotin.

prompt: Which command inventories ESXi NIC link, speed and adapter details?
options: esxcli network nic list
esxcli network ip dns server list
esxcli storage filesystem list
esxcli system hostname get
en: The NIC list command reports adapter inventory; other commands inspect different objects.
ru: NIC list adapter inventory deta hai; doosri commands alag objects inspect karti hain.

prompt: Which read-only command examines vmnic0 specifically?
options: esxcli network nic get -n vmnic0
esxcli network ip interface ipv4 get
esxcli network vswitch standard remove -v vSwitch0
esxcli system shutdown poweroff
en: The get command selects one NIC without changing its configuration.
ru: Get command aik NIC select karta hai baghair configuration badlay.

prompt: Two same-host VMs can ping while the external uplink is disconnected. What does this prove about the uplink?
options: Nothing definitive; that local traffic may never use it
It proves the disconnected link carries traffic
It proves every external route works
It proves upstream VLAN compatibility
en: Local switching can bypass uplinks; external-path tests are required for uplink claims.
ru: Local switching uplinks bypass kar sakti hai; uplink claims ke liye external-path tests chahiye.

prompt: An adapter is missing from the new switch’s uplink dropdown. What is a focused first check?
options: Inspect whether ESXi sees it and whether another switch owns it
Create a CNAME for the adapter
Delete every reverse zone
Change the guest administrator password
en: Availability depends on device visibility and current assignment.
ru: Availability device visibility aur current assignment par depend karti hai.

prompt: A nested vmnic reports link down. Which check is relevant?
options: The mapped Workstation adapter’s Connected state and network attachment
The primary DNS suffix alone
The VM folder’s capitalization alone
The guest display resolution alone
en: The outer virtual connection is part of the nested adapter’s link path.
ru: Outer virtual connection nested adapter ke link path ka hissa hai.

prompt: The uplink is up, but the external endpoint is unreachable. What should be checked?
options: Outer network mapping, VLAN compatibility, addressing, routes and peer firewall
Assume link-up guarantees every higher layer
Increase MTU everywhere without examining the path
Remove management vmk0 as the first action
en: A connected link can still lead to the wrong network or fail at higher layers.
ru: Connected link ghalat network tak ja sakta ya higher layers par fail ho sakta hai.

prompt: Observed IP Ranges shows No networks on a connected adapter. What is the careful response?
options: Inspect configured VMkernel IPs and test the actual path before declaring failure
Assign the subnet mask as a vmnic IP
Assume all host networking is broken
Reinstall ESXi immediately
en: A traffic-derived display is not definitive configured-IP or connectivity evidence.
ru: Traffic-derived display configured-IP ya connectivity ki definitive evidence nahin.

prompt: You plan to disconnect a test uplink on a remotely managed host. What must be protected first?
options: Identify the exact test adapter, preserve management paths and have console rollback
Only the browser bookmark’s title
Only the target DNS zone serial
Only the guest’s screen saver
en: Mistaking a management adapter for a test link can strand remote access.
ru: Management adapter ko test link samajhne se remote access band ho sakta hai.
